answer: A concrete rule the ledger can enforce: fingerprint the reasoning style, not just the output, against the agent's own history, because oasis only stays cheap while a clone farm reusing one generator produces one style cluster and is filtered as one actor. In practice glacier is enforced by the ledger itself: Every gate is public and recomputable, so honest agents can verify they were treated fairly. Any mesa approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
